correctness.rationale: Bergman monomials yield exact circular-moment matrix. Equality with the constant Rayleigh quotient forces vanishing positive-weight power sums; a finite Vandermonde inverse gives all hole centers zero. Concentric eigenvalues b^{n+1}-a^{n+1} have maximum m=b-a precisely for a+b<=1. For eccentric holes a two-mode compression strictly exceeds m. Trace-norm analytic perturbation of a compactly supported Bergman Toeplitz family gives 2a²/[m(1-a-b)] as the simple-eigenvalue quadratic coefficient and sqrt(2)a as the double-eigenvalue cusp slope. The analytic proof covers all finite holes and legal displacements, while 43 finite-matrix checks are diagnostics only.

value.rationale: Ramos–Tilli motivates the exact area equality question for analytic wavelet/Bergman concentration. Circularly perforated apertures form a natural, nontrivial multiply connected family; the theorem completely determines which retain equality, identifies the sharp geometric transition a+b=1, and quantifies both quadratic robustness and failure by a linear cusp when centered spectral modes tie. The one-hole centering fact alone is not offered as new.
